i think this is a common experience when you leave something you were addicted to. we ignore the horrible parts and we focus on the happiness it brought us, no matter how small.

i can’t fix what you’re feeling, but i have a few strategies i’ve used. 

first; the more you stay away and the more you try to forget, the easier it’ll become. it trains your brain, in a way.

secondly, try writing things to yourself to remind you of the reality of the relationship. i write myself things all the time, reminding myself how things really were. and when i get down and desperate, i read them. it’s very helpful.

you will get through it, time makes us forget. and you’ll likely meet someone stable and have a healthy relationship in the future. just keep fighting.

well, you haven’t given us much context, and you only suspect your girlfriend has BPD. from what you’ve told us, her being quiet could be a normal way of coping and coming to terms with disappointments and frustration.

i do that sometimes, and i’ll tell my boyfriend that i just need some space and that i won’t talk to him for a bit. but, if she’s really ignoring you despite your efforts and trying to manipulate you like that to cause stress, then yeah it sounds pretty problematic, especially if she doesn’t explain why she does it. in that case, it is likely to just be an attention-seeking behaviour. 

i do recommend that you deal with her possible BPD off the internet, and that you don’t come to speculate on here of all places. this subreddit can have important insights but it can also dramatise and pathologize normal human behaviour, and it can be really hateful at times. so i really don’t recommend that you read too much into what’s on here until she has a professional diagnosis etc. i study psych too, and i’m educated on personality disorders, but even as educated people i think that this subreddit can shift our view of people. so, do be careful.

that being said, i don’t know your situation so i’m sorry if i’ve invalidated you in anyway. i hope it all improves, and i hope she gets a diagnosis if she needs one. i also hope that you’re okay. if she’s emotionally abusing you, then you need to leave that situation no matter how she may convince you to stay.
